student:dashboard.nextAction.APPLICATION.en: The Hangyul team left comments. Your application can't be submitted until it's approved.
student:dashboard.nextAction.APPLICATION.cur: Hangyul Univ jamoasi izohlar qoldirdi. U tasdiqlanmaguncha arizangizni topshirib boʻlmaydi.

student:dashboard.nextAction.APPLICATION.en: The Hangyul team will review it with you. Start with a rough draft. It doesn't need to be perfect.
student:dashboard.nextAction.APPLICATION.cur: Hangyul jamoasi uni siz bilan birga koʻrib chiqadi. Qoralamadan boshlang. Mukammal boʻlishi shart emas.

student:legalFlow.note.JOINED.en: {{country}} joined the Apostille Convention on {{date}}. Documents legalized by the consulate before that date are generally still accepted. Confirm with your university.
student:legalFlow.note.JOINED.cur: {{country}} {{date}} kuni Apostil konvensiyasiga qoʻshildi. Bu sanadan oldin konsullikda legalizatsiya qilingan hujjatlar odatda hali ham qabul qilinadi. Universitetingizdan aniqlang.

student:legalFlow.note.JOINS.en: {{country}} joins the Apostille Convention on {{date}}. Until then, documents need Korean consular legalization.
student:legalFlow.note.JOINS.cur: {{country}} {{date}} kuni Apostil konvensiyasiga qoʻshiladi. Ungacha hujjatlar Koreya konsullik legalizatsiyasidan oʻtishi kerak.

student:legalFlow.note.UNVERIFIED.en: We have not verified the legalization route for this country yet. The Hangyul team will confirm.
student:legalFlow.note.UNVERIFIED.cur: Bu davlat uchun legalizatsiya tartibini hali tekshirmaganmiz. Hangyul jamoasi aniqlab beradi.

student:legalFlow.step.consular.title.en: Get consular legalization at the Korean embassy or consulate in {{country}}
student:legalFlow.step.consular.title.cur: {{country}}dagi Koreya elchixonasi yoki konsulligida konsullik legalizatsiyasidan oʻtkazing

student:settingsV3.translation.SYNTHETIC.en: This language is machine-translated and was checked by an automated review, not yet by a person ({{percent}}% of this app).
student:settingsV3.translation.SYNTHETIC.cur: Bu til mashina yordamida tarjima qilingan va avtomatik tekshiruvdan oʻtgan, lekin hali inson tomonidan tekshirilmagan (ilovaning {{percent}}% qismi).

student:v4.review.late.en: This is taking longer than usual, so we've flagged the delay to the Hangyul team. You don't need to upload it again.
student:v4.review.late.cur: Odatdagidan uzoqroq choʻzilmoqda. Hangyul jamoasiga kechikish haqida xabar berildi. Qayta yuklashingiz shart emas.

student:v4.unlock.ielts.en: With IELTS {{score}}, you would be eligible.

student:v4.unlock.topik.en: With TOPIK level {{level}}, you would be eligible.

student:v4.ws.team.final.en: Final check before you submit to {{university}}
student:v4.ws.team.final.cur: {{university}} ga arizani oʻzingiz topshirishingizdan oldin yakuniy tekshiruv

student:v4.ws.uni.waitingDetail.en: The university sees your file only after you submit it.
student:v4.ws.uni.waitingDetail.cur: Universitet hujjatlaringizni faqat siz topshirganingizdan keyin koʻradi.

student:v4.ws.why.changes.en: {{name}} asked for changes. See the comments.

student:v4.ws.you.doc.RENEW.en: Get a new {{label}}. This one has expired

student:v9.announced.rule.REFUND_TO_STUD.en: After a visa refusal, tuition would be refunded directly to an account in the student's name (standard agreement).
student:v9.announced.rule.REFUND_TO_STUD.cur: Viza rad etilsa, oʻqish toʻlovi toʻgʻridan-toʻgʻri talaba nomidagi hisobga qaytariladi (standart kelishuv).

student:v9.announced.rule.STUDY_DEPOSIT_.en: Students from some countries without a Korean test result would deposit study funds in a bank, paid out each semester.
student:v9.announced.rule.STUDY_DEPOSIT_.cur: Ayrim davlatlardan koreys tili sertifikatisiz keladigan talabalar oʻqish mablagʻini bankka qoʻyishi, u esa har semestrda boʻlib berilishi rejalashtirilgan.

student:v9.announced.rule.TOPIK4_FINANCI.en: Students with TOPIK level 4 (or KIIP level 4) would not need to show funds for the visa.
student:v9.announced.rule.TOPIK4_FINANCI.cur: TOPIK 4-daraja (yoki KIIP 4-bosqich) boʻlgan talabalar viza uchun mablagʻini koʻrsatishi shart boʻlmaydi.

student:v9.announced.title_one.en: {{count}} change announced, not in force yet
student:v9.announced.title_one.cur: {{count}} ta oʻzgarish eʼlon qilingan, hali kuchga kirmagan

student:v9.announced.title_other.en: {{count}} changes announced, not in force yet
student:v9.announced.title_other.cur: {{count}} ta oʻzgarish eʼlon qilingan, hali kuchga kirmagan

student:v9.discovery.scholarship_one.en: A scholarship you may qualify for

student:v9.discovery.scholarship_other.cur: Siz olishingiz mumkin boʻlgan {{count}} ta stipendiya

student:v9.family.consent.en: By making the link you agree to share the parts you selected with the person you send it to. We record every time it is opened.
student:v9.family.consent.cur: Havolani yaratsangiz, tanlagan qismlaringizni havolani yuboradigan odamingiz bilan ulashishga rozilik bildirasiz. Havola har safar ochilganda qayd etiladi.

student:v9.family.ctaText.en: A read-only link you control. No screenshots needed.
student:v9.family.ctaText.cur: Siz boshqaradigan faqat oʻqish uchun havola. Skrinshot kerak emas.

student:v9.family.never.en: Never shown: your messages, essays, notes from the Hangyul team, or any document file.
student:v9.family.never.cur: Hech qachon koʻrsatilmaydi: xabarlaringiz, esselaringiz, Hangyul jamoasining eslatmalari va hujjat fayllari.

student:v9.family.scopeHint.family_docum.en: Bank balance certificate and family documents: names only, never the files
student:v9.family.scopeHint.family_docum.cur: Bank qoldigʻi haqida maʼlumotnoma va oilaviy hujjatlar: faqat nomlari koʻrinadi, fayllar hech qachon koʻrinmaydi

student:v9.funds.genuine.en: The money must actually be in the account. Putting money in only to get a certificate and then taking it out is illegal in Korea.
student:v9.funds.genuine.cur: Pul haqiqatan ham hisobda turishi kerak. Faqat maʼlumotnoma olish uchun pul qoʻyib, keyin yana yechib olish Koreya qonunlariga zid.

student:v9.funds.kind.NOT_STATED.en: The embassy states no minimum amount. Plan for one year of tuition and living costs; the Hangyul team confirms.
student:v9.funds.kind.NOT_STATED.cur: Elchixona minimal miqdorni koʻrsatmagan. Bir yillik oʻqish toʻlovi va yashash xarajatlarini rejalashtiring; Hangyul jamoasi aniqlab beradi.

student:v9.funds.longer_one.en: {{count}} month if your university is in the lower tier (rated 'consulting' by the government)
student:v9.funds.longer_one.cur: Universitetingiz quyi toifada boʻlsa (hukumat bahosi: «konsalting»), {{count}} oy

student:v9.funds.longer_other.en: {{count}} months if your university is in the lower tier (rated 'consulting' by the government)
student:v9.funds.longer_other.cur: Universitetingiz quyi toifada boʻlsa (hukumat bahosi: «konsalting»), {{count}} oy

student:v9.funds.status.NO_ROUTE.en: We haven't checked the money rule for your embassy yet. The Hangyul team confirms it.
student:v9.funds.status.NO_ROUTE.cur: Elchixonangiz uchun mablagʻ qoidasini hali tekshirmaganmiz. Hangyul jamoasi aniqlab beradi.

student:v9.funds.sub.en: For the {{type}} visa, the embassy asks to see this money in the bank. It is not paid to anyone, but it must really be yours or your family's.
student:v9.funds.sub.cur: {{type}} vizasi uchun elchixona bu pulni bankda koʻrishni soʻraydi. U hech kimga toʻlanmaydi, lekin haqiqatan sizniki yoki oilangizniki boʻlishi kerak.

student:v9.funds.waived.en: Your university is in the top ('excellent') tier, so the embassy may not ask for this. The Hangyul team confirms.
student:v9.funds.waived.cur: Universitetingiz eng yuqori («aʼlo») toifada, shuning uchun elchixona buni soʻramasligi mumkin. Hangyul jamoasi aniqlab beradi.

student:v9.funds.whose.UNKNOWN.en: Whose name: the Hangyul team confirms with the embassy
student:v9.funds.whose.UNKNOWN.cur: Kimning nomida: Hangyul Univ jamoasi elchixonadan aniqlaydi

student:v9.guard.text.en: Pay the university directly, by bank transfer or the payment method the university lists, in the student's own name. Don't pay through money changers, agencies or anyone else's account: the university's account can be frozen, and refunds go only to the student's own account.
student:v9.guard.text.cur: Universitetga toʻgʻridan-toʻgʻri, bank oʻtkazmasi yoki universitet koʻrsatgan toʻlov usuli orqali, talabaning oʻz nomidan toʻlang. Valyuta ayirboshlovchilar, agentliklar yoki boshqa birovning hisobi orqali toʻlamang: universitet hisobi muzlatilishi mumkin, toʻlov esa faqat talabaning oʻz hisobiga qaytariladi.

student:v9.money.note.HANGYUL_FEE_NONE.en: Optional. Only if you choose a Hangyul plan.

student:v9.money.note.NHIS_D2.en: About this much per month, based on 2026 university notices (NHIS does not publish it). Starts when you apply for your residence card.
student:v9.money.note.NHIS_D2.cur: Oyiga taxminan shuncha, 2026-yilgi universitet eʼlonlari asosida (NHIS bu summani eʼlon qilmaydi). Chet ellik roʻyxat kartasiga ariza berganingizdan boshlab hisoblanadi.

student:v9.money.note.NHIS_D4.en: About this much per month (2026, university notices). For language students it starts 6 months after entry; many Korean language institutes require group insurance before that.
student:v9.money.note.NHIS_D4.cur: Oyiga taxminan shuncha (2026, universitet eʼlonlari). Til kursi talabalari uchun u kelgandan 6 oy oʻtib boshlanadi; koʻplab koreys tili markazlari undan oldin guruh sugʻurtasini talab qiladi.

student:v9.money.note.RESIDENCE_CARD_90_.en: For stays over 90 days. Apply within 90 days of arrival.
student:v9.money.note.RESIDENCE_CARD_90_.cur: 90 kundan ortiq qolish uchun. Kelganingizdan keyin 90 kun ichida ariza bering.

student:v9.money.note.VISA_FEE_AS_PUBLIS.en: The embassy publishes this fee in words. See the official wording.
student:v9.money.note.VISA_FEE_AS_PUBLIS.cur: Elchixona bu yigʻimni raqam bilan emas, soʻz bilan yozgan. Rasmiy matnni koʻring.

student:v9.money.note.VISA_FEE_NO_ROUTE.en: We haven't checked your embassy yet. The Hangyul team confirms.
student:v9.money.note.VISA_FEE_NO_ROUTE.cur: Elchixonangizni hali tekshirmaganmiz. Hangyul jamoasi aniqlab beradi.

student:v9.money.note.VISA_FEE_UNKNOWN.en: Not published for your route yet. The Hangyul team confirms.
student:v9.money.note.VISA_FEE_UNKNOWN.cur: Sizning yoʻnalishingiz uchun hali eʼlon qilinmagan. Hangyul jamoasi aniqlab beradi.

student:v9.money.payee.EMBASSY.en: To the Korean embassy or visa center

student:v9.money.payee.EVERYDAY.en: Food, transport and phone, paid as you go
student:v9.money.payee.EVERYDAY.cur: Oziq-ovqat, transport va telefon, kerak boʻlganda toʻlanadi

student:v9.money.when.BEFORE_VISA.en: Before you apply for your visa

student:v9.refund.ruleUnknown.en: The Hangyul team confirms the university's refund rule and amount with you.
student:v9.refund.ruleUnknown.cur: Hangyul Univ jamoasi universitetning pulni qaytarish qoidasi va miqdorini siz bilan aniqlashtiradi.

student:v9.routes.degreeNotYet.en: A {{degree}} program needs a language test first, but you can start now.
student:v9.routes.degreeNotYet.cur: {{degree}} dasturi uchun avval til imtihoni kerak, lekin hozirdan boshlashingiz mumkin.

student:v9.routes.eyebrow.en: Yes, you can study in Korea

student:v9.routes.notOffer.en: Counted from the requirements universities publish. This is not an offer and not a prediction. Universities decide.
student:v9.routes.notOffer.cur: Universitetlar eʼlon qilgan talablar asosida hisoblangan. Bu qabul taklifi ham, bashorat ham emas. Qarorni universitetlar qabul qiladi.

student:v9.sponsor.foot.en: Shared by {{name}} through Hangyul · facts as of {{date}}
student:v9.sponsor.foot.cur: {{name}} tomonidan Hangyul orqali ulashilgan · {{date}} holatiga koʻra. Barcha qarorlarni universitetlar va elchixonalar qabul qiladi.

student:v9.sponsor.noFiles.en: Only the names of the papers are shown here, never the files.
student:v9.sponsor.noFiles.cur: Bu yerda faqat hujjatlar nomlari koʻrsatiladi, fayllar hech qachon koʻrinmaydi.

student:v9.visa.caveat.SCHEDULED_CHANGE.en: The embassy has announced new rules from {{date}} (amount, papers, language level). They are not in force yet. Today's rules apply until then.
student:v9.visa.caveat.SCHEDULED_CHANGE.cur: Elchixona {{date}} dan yangi qoidalarni eʼlon qildi (miqdor, hujjatlar, til darajasi). Ular hali kuchga kirmagan. Ungacha amaldagi qoidalar qoʻllaniladi.

student:v9.visa.caveat.TB_POST_CONFLICT.en: The Almaty consulate and the embassy describe the TB test differently. The Hangyul team confirms which test Almaty accepts.
student:v9.visa.caveat.TB_POST_CONFLICT.cur: Olmaotadagi konsullik va elchixona sil (TB) tekshiruvini turlicha tavsiflaydi. Hangyul jamoasi Olmaota qaysi tekshiruvni qabul qilishini aniqlab beradi.

dossier:check.noTarget.en: Confirming only marks this as correct.
dossier:check.noTarget.cur: Tasdiqlash faqat buni toʻgʻri deb belgilaydi.

dossier:finding.POOR_SCAN.en: The image is small ({{width}}×{{height}} pixels), so the text may be hard to read. Please upload a clearer scan or a PDF.
dossier:finding.POOR_SCAN.cur: Tasvir kichik ({{width}}×{{height}} piksel), shuning uchun matnni oʻqish qiyin boʻlishi mumkin. Iltimos, aniqroq skan yoki PDF yuklang.

dossier:finding.SMALL_FILE.en: The file is very small and may be hard to read. Please upload a clearer scan or a PDF.
dossier:finding.SMALL_FILE.cur: Fayl juda kichik va uni oʻqish qiyin boʻlishi mumkin. Iltimos, aniqroq skan yoki PDF yuklang.

dossier:page.emptyText.en: Upload your passport first. We'll show which applications it can be used for.
dossier:page.emptyText.cur: Avval pasportingizni yuklang. Undan qaysi arizalar uchun foydalanish mumkinligini koʻrsatamiz.

dossier:page.method.en: Automatic checks read the text inside PDFs, not photos or scanned images. Your profile changes only when you confirm.
dossier:page.method.cur: Avtomatik tekshiruv PDF ichidagi matnni oʻqiydi, rasm va skanerlangan tasvirlarni oʻqimaydi. Profilingiz faqat siz tasdiqlaganingizda oʻzgaradi.

dossier:page.subtitle.en: Prepare each document once. We check where it can be used.
dossier:page.subtitle.cur: Har bir hujjatni bir marta tayyorlang. Undan qayerda foydalanish mumkinligini biz tekshiramiz.

dossier:reason.ESSAY_TO_WRITE.en: Write it in the Writing section first.

dossier:reason.EXPIRED.cur: Muddati {{date}} kuni tugagan. Yangi berilgan nusxa kerak.

dossier:reason.NEAR_EXPIRY_DATE.en: Expires on {{date}}, before {{university}}'s deadline. Get a renewed copy soon.
dossier:reason.NEAR_EXPIRY_DATE.cur: {{date}} kuni, {{university}} muddatidan oldin tugaydi. Tez orada yangilangan nusxasini oling.

dossier:reason.NEAR_TOO_OLD.en: {{university}} needs it issued within {{days}} days. This copy will be too old after {{until}}.
dossier:reason.NEAR_TOO_OLD.cur: {{university}} hujjat {{days}} kun ichida berilgan boʻlishini talab qiladi. Bu nusxa {{until}} dan keyin eskirgan hisoblanadi.

dossier:reason.READY.en: Ready to use as it is.

dossier:summary.S_IN_REVIEW.cur: Tekshirilmoqda, soʻng {{count}} ta ariza uchun tayyor boʻladi

dossier:summary.S_IN_REVIEW_one.en: Being checked, then ready for your application
dossier:summary.S_IN_REVIEW_one.cur: Tekshirilmoqda, soʻng arizangiz uchun tayyor boʻladi

dossier:summary.S_IN_REVIEW_other.en: Being checked, then ready for {{count}} applications
dossier:summary.S_IN_REVIEW_other.cur: Tekshirilmoqda, soʻng {{count}} ta ariza uchun tayyor boʻladi

dossier:summary.S_MISSING.cur: Hali yuklanmagan. {{count}} ta ariza uchun kerak

dossier:summary.S_MISSING_other.en: Not uploaded yet. Needed for {{count}} applications
dossier:summary.S_MISSING_other.cur: Hali yuklanmagan. {{count}} ta ariza uchun kerak

dossier:summary.S_NOT_NEEDED.en: Not needed for your current applications. Kept for later
dossier:summary.S_NOT_NEEDED.cur: Hozirgi arizalaringiz uchun kerak emas. Keyinroq uchun saqlab qoʻyildi

dossier:summary.S_OPTIONAL.en: Optional for {{universities}}. It can still help your application
dossier:summary.S_OPTIONAL.cur: {{universities}} uchun ixtiyoriy. Baribir arizangizga yordam berishi mumkin

dossier:upload.kept.en: Nothing to upload. We reuse your {{doc}}.

dossier:upload.replacing.en: This replaces {{title}}. Your applications will use the new copy.
dossier:upload.replacing.cur: Bu {{title}} oʻrnini egallaydi. Arizalaringiz yangi nusxadan foydalanadi.

dossier:upload.sendText.en: Your {{doc}} is already in your documents, so you can send it without uploading it again.
dossier:upload.sendText.cur: {{doc}} allaqachon hujjatlaringiz orasida, shuning uchun uni qayta yuklamasdan yuborishingiz mumkin.

dossier:v9.who.reviewersWhy.en: They check documents before they are sent

success:block.ready.en: Ready. Nothing else affects this application
success:block.ready.cur: Tayyor — bu arizaga boshqa hech narsa taʼsir qilmaydi

success:item.DEADLINE_PASSED.why.en: The Hangyul team can check for a later round or intake.
success:item.DEADLINE_PASSED.why.cur: Hangyul jamoasi keyingi bosqich yoki qabul davrini tekshirib koʻrishi mumkin.

success:item.DEADLINE_TIGHT.why.en: Steps like legalization take weeks. Start the slowest one today.
success:item.DEADLINE_TIGHT.why.cur: Legallashtirish kabi bandlar haftalab davom etadi — eng sekinini bugun boshlang.

success:item.DOC_IN_REVIEW.why.en: Usually within 2 working days. Nothing to do.
success:item.DOC_IN_REVIEW.why.cur: Odatda 2 ish kuni ichida — hech narsa qilish shart emas.

success:item.DOC_REVIEW_LATE.why.en: It's taking longer than usual. We've told your counselor.
success:item.DOC_REVIEW_LATE.why.cur: Odatdagidan uzoqroq davom etmoqda — maslahatchingizga xabar berildi.

success:item.ESSAY_REVIEW.why.en: Nothing to do. Your counselor is reading it.
success:item.ESSAY_REVIEW.why.cur: Hech narsa qilish shart emas — maslahatchingiz uni oʻqimoqda.

success:item.FIELD_DIFFERENT.why.en: That's fine if you chose it on purpose. Your study plan should explain why.
success:item.FIELD_DIFFERENT.why.cur: Agar bu ongli tanlov boʻlsa, muammo yoʻq — oʻquv rejangiz buning sababini tushuntirishi kerak.

success:item.FINAL_CHECK.title.en: Everything is in. The final check is next

success:item.LANGUAGE_RECOMMENDED.why.en: Classes in Korean are demanding, and a higher level helps you keep up. It is not required to apply.
success:item.LANGUAGE_RECOMMENDED.why.cur: Koreys tilidagi darslar qiyin — yuqoriroq daraja ortda qolmaslikka yordam beradi. Ariza berish uchun bu majburiy emas.

success:item.SCHOLARSHIP_APPLY.why.en: It needs a separate application. You appear to meet its published criteria.
success:item.SCHOLARSHIP_APPLY.why.cur: Unga alohida ariza kerak — siz uning eʼlon qilingan mezonlariga javob berayotganga oʻxshaysiz.

success:item.SCHOLARSHIP_NONE.why.en: You said you need one. Ask your counselor about other options.
success:item.SCHOLARSHIP_NONE.why.cur: Sizga stipendiya kerakligini aytgansiz — boshqa imkoniyatlar haqida maslahatchingizdan soʻrang.

success:item.SUBMISSION_CONFIRM.why.en: You told us you submitted. Add the confirmation number or receipt to finish.
success:item.SUBMISSION_CONFIRM.why.cur: Siz topshirganingizni aytdingiz — tasdiq raqami yoki kvitansiya buni yakunlaydi.

success:obs.ADMITTED.en: You accepted a place at {{university}}. Your plan is set.
success:obs.ADMITTED.cur: {{university}} dagi oʻrinni qabul qildingiz — reja aniq.

success:obs.ALL_NOT_YET.en: None of your applications meets every published minimum yet. Add an option you already qualify for.
success:obs.ALL_NOT_YET.cur: Arizalaringizning hech biri hali barcha eʼlon qilingan eng kam talablarga javob bermaydi — hozir talabga javob beradigan variantni qoʻshing.

success:obs.ALL_OVER_BUDGET.en: Every application is above your budget. Plan your funding or add a lower-cost option.
success:obs.ALL_OVER_BUDGET.cur: Har bir ariza byudjetingizdan yuqoridan boshlanadi — mablagʻni rejalashtiring yoki arzonroq variant qoʻshing.

success:obs.ALL_POSSIBLE.en: All your applications are Possible matches. Consider adding one Strong match.
success:obs.ALL_POSSIBLE.cur: Barcha arizalaringiz Ehtimoliy moslik — bitta Kuchli moslik qoʻshishni oʻylab koʻring.

success:obs.COMPARE_OFFERS.en: You have {{count}} offers. Compare them side by side before you decide.
success:obs.COMPARE_OFFERS.cur: Sizda {{count}} ta taklif bor — qaror qilishdan oldin ularni yonma-yon solishtiring.

success:obs.FEW_OPTIONS.en: You're applying to one program. A second realistic option protects you if you are not admitted.
success:obs.FEW_OPTIONS.cur: Siz bitta dasturga ariza beryapsiz — agar u chiqmasa, ikkinchi real variant sizni himoya qiladi.

success:obs.MANY_APPLICATIONS.en: {{count}} applications in progress. Each needs its own essays and checks.
success:obs.MANY_APPLICATIONS.cur: {{count}} ta ariza jarayonda — har biriga alohida esse va tekshiruvlar kerak.

success:obs.NO_APPLICATIONS.en: You haven't started an application yet. Your Strong matches are a good place to begin.
success:obs.NO_APPLICATIONS.cur: Siz hali ariza boshlamagansiz — Kuchli mosliklaringizdan boshlash yaxshi.

success:obs.SOME_NOT_YET.en: You don't yet meet a published minimum for {{universities}}. Check that it's worth the effort.
success:obs.SOME_NOT_YET.cur: {{universities}}: eʼlon qilingan eng kam talablardan biri hali bajarilmagan — bunga kuch sarflashga arziydimi, tekshiring.

success:portfolio.note.en: This helps you decide. Hangyul never chooses for you. Costs are estimates before scholarships.
success:portfolio.note.cur: Bu sizga qaror qilishda yordam beradi. Hangyul hech qachon siz uchun tanlamaydi. Xarajatlar stipendiyalarsiz taxminiy hisoblangan.

success:portfolio.reviewed.cur: {{name}} {{date}} da ariza topshirish rejangizni koʻrib chiqdi.

success:portfolio.sub.en: Your applications and saved programs together, so you can see the whole picture.
success:portfolio.sub.cur: Umumiy manzarani koʻrishingiz uchun arizalaringiz va saqlangan dasturlaringiz bir joyda.

success:submission.authorize.changed.en: A document changed after you gave authorization. {{agency}} will check it with you before submitting.
success:submission.authorize.changed.cur: Ruxsat berganingizdan keyin hujjat oʻzgardi — {{agency}} topshirishdan oldin buni siz bilan tekshiradi.

success:submission.authorize.withdrawn.cur: Ruxsat qaytarib olindi — hech narsa topshirilmagan.

success:submission.fee.PAID.en: Application fee {{amount}}. You told us it's paid

success:submission.fee.UNPAID.en: Application fee {{amount}}, paid to {{payee}} on the portal
success:submission.fee.UNPAID.cur: Ariza toʻlovi {{amount}}, {{payee}} ga toʻlanadi — uni portalda toʻlaysiz

success:submission.fee.UNPAID_NP.en: Application fee {{amount}}. You pay it on the portal

success:submission.fee.separate.en: This is the university's application fee. It is not your Hangyul service fee or tuition.
success:submission.fee.separate.cur: Bu universitetning ariza toʻlovi — Hangyul xizmat toʻlovi ham, oʻqish toʻlovi ham emas.

success:submission.guided.enterHint.en: From your Hangyul profile. Type your passport number from the passport itself, because Hangyul keeps it only in masked form.
success:submission.guided.enterHint.cur: Hangyul profilingizdan. Pasport raqamingizni pasportning oʻzidan qarab yozing — Hangyul uni faqat yashirilgan holda saqlaydi.

success:submission.guided.originals.en: Keep the originals. {{university}} asks for them by post.
success:submission.guided.originals.cur: Asl nusxalarni saqlab qoʻying — {{university}} ularni pochta orqali soʻraydi.

success:submission.partial.en: Partly verified. Your counselor will confirm the details.

success:submission.placeholder.en: Submission method not yet verified. Your counselor will confirm it.
success:submission.placeholder.cur: Topshirish usuli hali tekshirilmagan — maslahatchingiz tasdiqlaydi.

success:submission.safety.en: Never share your portal password. Hangyul will never ask for it.
success:submission.safety.cur: Portal parolingizni hech kimga bermang — Hangyul uni hech qachon soʻramaydi.

success:submission.savedConfirmed.en: Confirmed. Your application is marked as submitted.

success:submission.selfRequired.en: {{university}} requires you to submit the application yourself on {{portal}}. Everything is prepared, and this takes about {{minutes}} minutes.
success:submission.selfRequired.cur: {{university}} arizani {{portal}} da oʻzingiz topshirishingizni talab qiladi. Hammasi tayyorlangan — bu taxminan {{minutes}} daqiqa oladi.

success:submission.sessionExpired.en: Your session expired. Sign in again. Nothing was saved.
success:submission.sessionExpired.cur: Seansingiz tugadi — qayta kiring. Hech narsa saqlanmadi.

success:submission.unconfirmedTitle.en: You told us you submitted. Add your confirmation to finish
success:submission.unconfirmedTitle.cur: Topshirganingizni aytdingiz — yakunlash uchun tasdiqni qoʻshing

writing:auto.studentNote.en: An automatic check that follows rules, not a person. It points out sentences to check and never changes or writes your text.
writing:auto.studentNote.cur: Bu inson emas, qoidalar. U tekshirish kerak boʻlgan gaplarni koʻrsatadi — matningizni hech qachon oʻzgartirmaydi yoki yozmaydi.

writing:finding.GENERIC_PHRASE.en: Many applicants use this phrase. A concrete detail from your own experience says more.
writing:finding.GENERIC_PHRASE.cur: Koʻplab nomzodlar bu iborani ishlatadi — oʻz tajribangizdan aniq bir tafsilot koʻproq narsani aytadi.

writing:finding.LONG_SENTENCE.en: A {{words}}-word sentence. Consider splitting it so it is easier to follow.
writing:finding.LONG_SENTENCE.cur: {{words}} soʻzli gap — oʻquvchi tushunishi uchun uni boʻlishni oʻylab koʻring.

writing:finding.NAME_MISSPELLED.en: Did you mean “{{expected}}” instead of “{{found}}”? Names must be exactly right.
writing:finding.NAME_MISSPELLED.cur: “{{found}}” — “{{expected}}” demoqchimisiz? Nomlar aynan toʻgʻri boʻlishi kerak.

writing:finding.NOT_SPECIFIC.en: The text never mentions {{university}} or the program. As written, it could be sent to any university.
writing:finding.NOT_SPECIFIC.cur: Matnda {{university}} ham, dastur ham tilga olinmagan — hozirgi holida uni istalgan universitetga yuborish mumkin.

writing:finding.OTHER_PROGRAM.en: Names the {{found}} program, but this application is for {{expected}}. Check that the paragraph wasn't reused.
writing:finding.OTHER_PROGRAM.cur: {{found}} dasturi nomi keltirilgan — bu ariza {{expected}} uchun. Xatboshi qayta ishlatilmaganini tekshiring.

writing:finding.OTHER_UNIVERSITY.en: Mentions {{name}}, but this text is for {{target}}. Check that it wasn't copied from another application.
writing:finding.OTHER_UNIVERSITY.cur: {{name}} tilga olingan — bu matn {{target}} uchun. U boshqa arizadan koʻchirilmaganini tekshiring.

writing:finding.OVERCLAIM.en: An absolute claim. Readers trust evidence more than superlatives.
writing:finding.OVERCLAIM.cur: Mutlaq daʼvo — oʻquvchilar maqtov soʻzlaridan koʻra dalillarga koʻproq ishonadi.

writing:finding.OVER_CHAR_LIMIT.cur: {{count}} ta belgi — {{limit}} belgilik chegaradan {{over}} ta ortiq.

writing:finding.OVER_LIMIT.cur: {{count}} ta soʻz — {{limit}} soʻzlik chegaradan {{over}} ta ortiq.

writing:finding.PROMPT_PART_MISSING_one.en: Automatic check: {{count}} part of the question may be unanswered. Rate “Answers the question” to confirm
writing:finding.PROMPT_PART_MISSING_one.cur: Avtomatik tekshiruv: savolning {{count}} ta qismiga javob berilmagan boʻlishi mumkin — tasdiqlash uchun “Savolga javob beradi” bandini baholang

writing:finding.PROMPT_PART_MISSING_othe.en: Automatic check: {{count}} parts of the question may be unanswered. Rate “Answers the question” to confirm
writing:finding.PROMPT_PART_MISSING_othe.cur: Avtomatik tekshiruv: savolning {{count}} ta qismiga javob berilmagan boʻlishi mumkin — tasdiqlash uchun “Savolga javob beradi” bandini baholang

writing:finding.REPEATED_OPENER.en: {{count}} sentences start the same way. Try varying how sentences begin.
writing:finding.REPEATED_OPENER.cur: {{count}} ta gap bir xil boshlanadi — gaplarni turlicha boshlang.

writing:finding.SIMILAR_TEXT.en: Passages ({{passages}}) are identical to another document in Hangyul. Talk to the student before approving, and never share the other text.
writing:finding.SIMILAR_TEXT.cur: Parchalar ({{passages}}) Hangyuldagi boshqa hujjat bilan bir xil. Tasdiqlashdan oldin talaba bilan gaplashing — boshqa matnni hech qachon koʻrsatmang.

writing:finding.UNDER_CHAR_LENGTH.en: {{count}} of {{limit}} characters. There is room for more detail.
writing:finding.UNDER_CHAR_LENGTH.cur: {{limit}} ta belgidan {{count}} tasi — koʻproq tafsilot uchun joy bor.

writing:finding.UNDER_LENGTH.en: {{count}} of {{limit}} words. There is room for more detail.
writing:finding.UNDER_LENGTH.cur: {{limit}} ta soʻzdan {{count}} tasi — koʻproq tafsilot uchun joy bor.

writing:prompt.unknownStudent.en: We don't have this university's exact question yet. Your counselor will confirm it. You can start writing about your motivation, background and plans.
writing:prompt.unknownStudent.cur: Bu universitetning aniq savoli hali bizda yoʻq — maslahatchingiz uni tasdiqlaydi. Motivatsiyangiz, tajribangiz va rejalaringiz haqida yozishni boshlashingiz mumkin.

writing:sl.LATE.en: Taking longer than expected. {{name}} is working on it.
writing:sl.LATE.cur: Kutilganidan uzoqroq davom etmoqda — hozir uni {{name}} koʻrib chiqmoqda.

writing:sl.LATE_FLAGGED.en: Taking longer than expected. We've told the {{org}} manager. You don't need to do anything.
writing:sl.LATE_FLAGGED.cur: Kutilganidan uzoqroq davom etmoqda — {{org}} rahbariga xabar berildi. Siz hech narsa qilishingiz shart emas.

writing:sl.LATE_FLAGGED_HANGYUL.en: Taking longer than expected. We've told the Hangyul team. You don't need to do anything.
writing:sl.LATE_FLAGGED_HANGYUL.cur: Kutilganidan uzoqroq davom etmoqda — Hangyul jamoasiga xabar berildi. Siz hech narsa qilishingiz shart emas.

writing:student.checked.en: Checked. Nothing in your text was changed

writing:student.factsSub.en: They say something different from your profile. Only you can decide which is right. Fix the sentence or update your profile.
writing:student.factsSub.cur: Ularda profilingizdagidan boshqacha maʼlumot bor. Qaysi biri toʻgʻriligini faqat siz hal qila olasiz — gapni tuzating yoki profilingizni yangilang.

writing:student6.accepted.en: You accepted this. Saved as version {{version}}
writing:student6.accepted.cur: Siz buni qabul qildingiz — {{version}}-versiya sifatida saqlandi

writing:student6.acceptedToast.en: Suggestion accepted. Your text is updated

writing:student6.approvedVersion.en: Approved and used by your application

writing:student6.noComments.en: No comments yet. Your reviewer's notes will appear here, next to your text.
writing:student6.noComments.cur: Hali izohlar yoʻq — tekshiruvchingiz eslatmalari shu yerda, matningiz yonida paydo boʻladi.

writing:student6.pendingNote_one.en: {{count}} suggestion is still open. That's fine. You can choose not to accept it.
writing:student6.pendingNote_one.cur: {{count}} ta taklif hali ochiq. Bu normal — uni qabul qilmaslik sizning tanlovingiz.

writing:student6.pendingNote_other.en: {{count}} suggestions are still open. That's fine. You can choose not to accept them.
writing:student6.pendingNote_other.cur: {{count}} ta taklif hali ochiq. Bu normal — ularni qabul qilmaslik sizning tanlovingiz.

writing:student6.usedBy.en: Version {{version}} is approved. Your {{university}} application uses it.

visaroute:caveat.AMOUNTS_CONFLICT.en: Two official pages give different amounts for proof of funds. Your counselor confirms the current one.
visaroute:caveat.AMOUNTS_CONFLICT.cur: Ikki rasmiy sahifada mablagʻni tasdiqlash uchun turli summalar koʻrsatilgan. Maslahatchingiz amaldagisini aniqlaydi.

visaroute:caveat.APOSTILLE_TRANSITION.en: Viet Nam started issuing apostilles on 11 Sep 2026, but the embassy's student visa lists still describe consular legalization. The Hangyul team confirms which one is accepted.
visaroute:caveat.APOSTILLE_TRANSITION.cur: Vyetnam 2026-yil 11-sentabrdan apostil bera boshladi, lekin elchixonaning talaba vizasi roʻyxatlarida hali ham konsullik legallashtiruvi yozilgan. Qaysi biri qabul qilinishini Hangyul jamoasi aniqlaydi.

visaroute:caveat.APOSTILLE_WORDING_POSTS.en: The Mumbai checklist doesn't mention the apostille that Delhi and Chennai ask for. Your counselor confirms.
visaroute:caveat.APOSTILLE_WORDING_POSTS.cur: Mumbay roʻyxatida Dehli va Chennay soʻraydigan apostil haqida gap yoʻq. Maslahatchingiz aniqlaydi.

visaroute:caveat.CCVI_TIER_UNKNOWN.en: Depending on {{university}}'s certification level, the university may first need to apply for a Certificate of Confirmation of Visa Issuance (CCVI). Your counselor checks.
visaroute:caveat.CCVI_TIER_UNKNOWN.cur: {{university}}ning sertifikat darajasiga qarab, universitet avval viza berishni tasdiqlovchi sertifikat (CCVI) soʻrashi kerak boʻlishi mumkin. Maslahatchingiz tekshiradi.

visaroute:caveat.DIPLOMA_APOSTILLE_POSTS.en: The two offices differ. Astana requires an apostille on the diploma; Almaty says it is not mandatory. Your counselor confirms what your office needs.
visaroute:caveat.DIPLOMA_APOSTILLE_POSTS.cur: Ikki vakolatxona talablari farq qiladi. Astana diplomga apostil talab qiladi; Olmaota esa bu majburiy emas deydi. Sizning vakolatxonangizga nima kerakligini maslahatchingiz aniqlaydi.

visaroute:caveat.EVISA_TIER_UNKNOWN.en: If {{university}} holds the government's 'excellent' certification (or 'certified' for master's and doctoral study), the university can apply for an e-visa for you instead. We haven't confirmed its level. The Hangyul team checks.
visaroute:caveat.EVISA_TIER_UNKNOWN.cur: Agar {{university}} hukumatning «aʼlo» sertifikatiga (magistratura va doktorantura uchun «sertifikatlangan») ega boʻlsa, universitet oʻrningizga elektron vizaga ariza berishi mumkin. Uning darajasini hali tasdiqlamaganmiz. Hangyul jamoasi tekshiradi.

visaroute:caveat.FEES_MISSING.en: The embassy doesn't publish the fee or processing time. Your counselor confirms them.
visaroute:caveat.FEES_MISSING.cur: Elchixona yigʻim va koʻrib chiqish muddatini eʼlon qilmaydi. Maslahatchingiz ularni aniqlaydi.

visaroute:caveat.FEE_EXEMPTION_UNCHECKED.en: We still need to check whether Thai nationals pay the visa fee. Your counselor confirms.
visaroute:caveat.FEE_EXEMPTION_UNCHECKED.cur: Tailand fuqarolari viza yigʻimini toʻlashi kerakmi, buni hali tekshirishimiz kerak. Maslahatchingiz aniqlaydi.

visaroute:caveat.FEE_TIME_CONFLICT.en: Official pages disagree on the fee and processing time. Your counselor confirms them.
visaroute:caveat.FEE_TIME_CONFLICT.cur: Rasmiy sahifalarda yigʻim va koʻrib chiqish muddati turlicha. Maslahatchingiz ularni aniqlaydi.

visaroute:caveat.FUNDS_PERIOD_CONFLICT.en: The embassy and the national manual differ on how many months of funds language students must show. Your counselor confirms.
visaroute:caveat.FUNDS_PERIOD_CONFLICT.cur: Til kursi talabalari necha oylik mablagʻni koʻrsatishi kerakligi boʻyicha elchixona va milliy qoʻllanma farq qiladi. Maslahatchingiz aniqlaydi.

visaroute:caveat.LEGALIZATION_UNCLEAR.en: The embassy's list and the national visa manual differ on how your school documents must be authenticated: a translated copy or consular legalization. Your counselor confirms which one you need.
visaroute:caveat.LEGALIZATION_UNCLEAR.cur: Maktab hujjatlaringiz qanday tasdiqlanishi kerakligi boʻyicha elchixona roʻyxati va milliy viza qoʻllanmasi farq qiladi: tarjima nusxasi yoki konsullik legalizatsiyasi. Qaysi biri kerakligini maslahatchingiz aniqlaydi.

visaroute:caveat.POST_SPLIT_UNVERIFIED.en: We couldn't confirm which regions the Manila and Cebu offices each cover. Your counselor tells you where to apply.
visaroute:caveat.POST_SPLIT_UNVERIFIED.cur: Manila va Sebu vakolatxonalari qaysi hududlarga xizmat qilishini tasdiqlay olmadik. Qayerda ariza berishni maslahatchingiz aytadi.

visaroute:caveat.POST_UNRESOLVED.en: We couldn't confirm which embassy or consulate covers your area. Your counselor tells you where to apply.
visaroute:caveat.POST_UNRESOLVED.cur: Hududingizga qaysi elchixona yoki konsullik xizmat qilishini tasdiqlay olmadik. Qayerda ariza berishni maslahatchingiz aytadi.

visaroute:caveat.ROUTE_PARTIAL.en: Some details for this route are not confirmed yet. The Hangyul team checks with the embassy before you apply.
visaroute:caveat.ROUTE_PARTIAL.cur: Bu yoʻnalishning ayrim tafsilotlari hali tasdiqlanmagan. Ariza berishingizdan oldin Hangyul jamoasi ularni elchixonadan aniqlaydi.

visaroute:caveat.STALE_LIST.en: The embassy's document list is from 2019. Your counselor checks that it is still current.
visaroute:caveat.STALE_LIST.cur: Elchixonaning hujjatlar roʻyxati 2019-yilga oid. Maslahatchingiz u hali ham amaldaligini tekshiradi.

visaroute:caveat.STALE_VERIFICATION.en: These rules were last checked on {{date}}. Your counselor checks them again before you apply.
visaroute:caveat.STALE_VERIFICATION.cur: Bu qoidalar oxirgi marta {{date}} kuni tekshirilgan. Ariza berishingizdan oldin maslahatchingiz ularni qayta tekshiradi.

visaroute:caveat.TB_VALIDITY_CONFLICT.en: Official pages disagree on how long the TB certificate is valid (3 or 6 months). We use the stricter 3 months.
visaroute:caveat.TB_VALIDITY_CONFLICT.cur: Rasmiy sahifalarda sil (TB) maʼlumotnomasining amal qilish muddati turlicha (3 yoki 6 oy). Biz qatʼiyroq boʻlgan 3 oyni olamiz.

visaroute:cond.LOWER_TIER.en: Only for some universities. Your counselor confirms.
visaroute:cond.LOWER_TIER.cur: Faqat ayrim universitetlar uchun. Maslahatchingiz aniqlaydi.

visaroute:cond.OTHER.en: Only in some cases. The Hangyul team confirms.
visaroute:cond.OTHER.cur: Faqat ayrim hollarda. Hangyul jamoasi aniqlaydi.

visaroute:cond.POST_SPECIFIC.en: Only some embassies or consulates ask for this. It depends on where you apply.
visaroute:cond.POST_SPECIFIC.cur: Buni faqat ayrim elchixona yoki konsulliklar soʻraydi. Bu qayerda ariza berishingizga bogʻliq.

visaroute:doc.business_registration.why.en: The university's business registration. It comes with your admission papers.
visaroute:doc.business_registration.why.cur: Universitetning davlat roʻyxatidan oʻtganlik guvohnomasi. U qabul hujjatlaringiz bilan birga keladi.

visaroute:doc.criminal_record.why.en: Shows you have no criminal record. Issued by the police.

visaroute:doc.other_address_certificate..en: Proves where you live, which decides where you apply.
visaroute:doc.other_address_certificate..cur: Yashash joyingizni tasdiqlaydi, bu esa qayerda ariza berishingizni belgilaydi.

visaroute:doc.other_air_ticket_booking.w.en: A booking, not a paid ticket. Some embassies ask for it.
visaroute:doc.other_air_ticket_booking.w.cur: Toʻlangan chipta emas, bron. Ayrim elchixonalar buni soʻraydi.

visaroute:doc.other_declaration_form.why.en: The embassy's or consulate's own form. You sign it yourself.
visaroute:doc.other_declaration_form.why.cur: Elchixona yoki konsullikning oʻz shakli. Uni oʻzingiz imzolaysiz.

visaroute:doc.other_health_condition_rep.en: A health form some embassies and consulates ask for.
visaroute:doc.other_health_condition_rep.cur: Ayrim elchixona va konsulliklar soʻraydigan tibbiy shakl.

visaroute:doc.other_passport_record.name.en: Passport issuance record (from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs)
visaroute:doc.other_passport_record.name.cur: Pasport berilganligi haqidagi maʼlumotnoma (Tashqi ishlar vazirligidan)

visaroute:doc.sponsor_documents.why.en: ID and proof of income or employment for the person paying your costs.
visaroute:doc.sponsor_documents.why.cur: Toʻlovchi shaxsning ID hujjati va daromadi yoki ish joyini tasdiqlovchi hujjat.

visaroute:doc.tb_test.why.en: Required for your nationality for stays over 90 days. Get it from a clinic the embassy designates.
visaroute:doc.tb_test.why.cur: Fuqaroligingiz uchun 90 kundan ortiq qolishda talab qilinadi. Uni elchixona belgilagan klinikadan oling.

visaroute:docs.maybeSub.en: The Hangyul team confirms whether these apply to you.
visaroute:docs.maybeSub.cur: Bular sizga taalluqli yoki yoʻqligini Hangyul jamoasi aniqlaydi.

visaroute:docs.previewSub.en: From the embassy's list for your nationality. The full plan opens once your university issues your admission letter.
visaroute:docs.previewSub.cur: Fuqaroligingiz uchun elchixona roʻyxatidan. Universitet qabul xatingizni bergach, toʻliq reja ochiladi.

visaroute:docs.readyCount.cur: {{count}} ta tayyor, {{reused}} tasi hujjatlaringizdan qayta ishlatilgan

visaroute:form.correctedHint.en: You changed this here only. If it's wrong in your profile, update it there too.
visaroute:form.correctedHint.cur: Buni faqat shu yerda oʻzgartirdingiz. Profilingizda ham xato boʻlsa, u yerda ham yangilang.

visaroute:form.missingHint.en: We don't have this. You'll write it on the official form.
visaroute:form.missingHint.cur: Bu maʼlumot bizda yoʻq. Uni rasmiy anketaga oʻzingiz yozasiz.

visaroute:form.notice.en: For your preparation only. You'll fill in and sign the official form yourself (or your university applies for the e-visa). Hangyul never submits or declares anything for you.
visaroute:form.notice.cur: Faqat tayyorgarlik uchun. Rasmiy shaklni oʻzingiz toʻldirasiz va imzolaysiz (yoki elektron vizaga universitetingiz ariza beradi). Hangyul hech qachon siz uchun hech narsa topshirmaydi yoki maʼlum qilmaydi.

visaroute:help.askHint.en: Your question goes to the Hangyul team and its visa specialists.
visaroute:help.askHint.cur: Savolingiz Hangyul jamoasi va uning viza mutaxassislariga yuboriladi.

visaroute:help.issue.IN_KOREA.needed.en: A change of status goes through the immigration office. Your counselor guides you.
visaroute:help.issue.IN_KOREA.needed.cur: Maqomni oʻzgartirish immigratsiya idorasi orqali amalga oshiriladi. Maslahatchingiz yoʻl-yoʻriq beradi.

visaroute:help.issue.NEEDS_ANSWER.needed.en: Answer the question above and we'll tell you which embassy or consulate to apply to.
visaroute:help.issue.NEEDS_ANSWER.needed.cur: Yuqoridagi savolga javob bering, qaysi elchixona yoki konsullikka ariza berishni aytamiz.

visaroute:help.issue.OTHER_RESIDENCE.nee.en: Your counselor checks whether the Korean embassy or consulate where you live accepts your application.
visaroute:help.issue.OTHER_RESIDENCE.nee.cur: Maslahatchingiz yashash joyingizdagi Koreya elchixonasi yoki konsulligi arizangizni qabul qilish-qilmasligini tekshiradi.

visaroute:help.sent.en: Sent. Your counselor will reply in Messages.

visaroute:home.choose_post.en: Tell us where you live so we can find the right embassy
visaroute:home.choose_post.cur: Toʻgʻri elchixonani tanlashimiz uchun qayerda yashashingizni ayting

visaroute:home.embassy_request.en: The embassy asked for something. Send it by {{date}}
visaroute:home.embassy_request.cur: Elchixona qoʻshimcha narsa soʻradi. {{date}} gacha yuboring

visaroute:home.refused.en: Your visa was refused. Your counselor will help you with the next step
visaroute:home.refused.cur: Vizangiz rad etildi. Keyingi qadamda maslahatchingiz yordam beradi

visaroute:home.wait_decision.en: Visa application submitted. Waiting for the embassy
visaroute:home.wait_decision.cur: Viza arizasi topshirildi. Elchixona javobini kutyapmiz

visaroute:home.waiting.en: Your visa documents are being handled. Nothing to do right now
visaroute:home.waiting.cur: Viza hujjatlaringiz ustida ish olib borilmoqda. Hozircha qiladigan ish yoʻq

visaroute:method.CCVI.en: university gets a Certificate of Confirmation of Visa Issuance (CCVI), then you apply at the embassy
visaroute:method.CCVI.cur: universitet viza berishni tasdiqlovchi sertifikat (CCVI) oladi, soʻng siz elchixonaga ariza berasiz

visaroute:methodNote.ACCREDITED_ONLY.en: You can apply only through agencies the embassy has accredited. Check the embassy's list.
visaroute:methodNote.ACCREDITED_ONLY.cur: Faqat elchixona akkreditatsiya qilgan agentliklar orqali ariza berishingiz mumkin. Elchixona roʻyxatini tekshiring.

visaroute:methodNote.AGENCIES_ONLY_FROM_.en: From 1 Oct 2026, this embassy or consulate takes applications only through its designated travel agencies.
visaroute:methodNote.AGENCIES_ONLY_FROM_.cur: 2026-yil 1-oktabrdan bu elchixona yoki konsullik arizalarni faqat oʻzi belgilagan turistik agentliklar orqali qabul qiladi.

visaroute:methodNote.G4K_BOOKING.en: Book online at g4k.go.kr, then go to the consulate in person. No one can apply for you.
visaroute:methodNote.G4K_BOOKING.cur: g4k.go.kr saytida onlayn navbat oling, soʻng konsullikka shaxsan boring. Siz uchun hech kim ariza bera olmaydi.

visaroute:page.subtitle.en: Your visa plan for your country and university: what you need, in what order, and where to apply.
visaroute:page.subtitle.cur: Davlatingiz va universitetingiz uchun viza rejasi: nima kerak, qanday tartibda va qayerda ariza berish.

visaroute:question.unsure.en: Not sure? Ask the Hangyul team.
visaroute:question.unsure.cur: Ishonchingiz komil emasmi? Hangyul jamoasidan soʻrang.

visaroute:question.why.en: Each embassy or consulate accepts students only from the area it covers. This decides where you apply.
visaroute:question.why.cur: Har bir elchixona yoki konsullik faqat oʻzi xizmat qiladigan hududdagi talabalarni qabul qiladi. Bu qayerda ariza berishingizni belgilaydi.

visaroute:reason.EXPIRED.en: It has expired. You need a newly issued copy.
visaroute:reason.EXPIRED.cur: Muddati tugagan. Yangi berilgan nusxa kerak.

visaroute:reason.GET_LATER.en: Don't get it yet. Get it on or after {{date}} so it's still valid on {{appointment}}.
visaroute:reason.GET_LATER.cur: Hozircha olmang. {{appointment}} kuni ham amal qilishi uchun uni {{date}} yoki undan keyin oling.

visaroute:reason.NEAR_EXPIRY_DATE.en: Expires on {{date}}. Renew it before you apply.
visaroute:reason.NEAR_EXPIRY_DATE.cur: Muddati {{date}} kuni tugaydi. Ariza berishdan oldin yangilang.

visaroute:reason.PASSPORT_VALIDITY.en: Your passport expires on {{date}}. Many embassies ask for at least 6 months of validity.
visaroute:reason.PASSPORT_VALIDITY.cur: Pasportingiz muddati {{date}} kuni tugaydi. Koʻp elchixonalar kamida 6 oylik amal qilish muddatini talab qiladi.

visaroute:reason.TB_AT_REGISTRATION.en: With the e-visa, you submit the TB certificate when you register as a foreign resident in Korea.
visaroute:reason.TB_AT_REGISTRATION.cur: Elektron viza bilan sil (TB) maʼlumotnomasini Koreyada chet ellik sifatida roʻyxatdan oʻtayotganda topshirasiz.

visaroute:reason.VISA_ONLY.en: Only the visa needs this. It isn't in your documents yet.
visaroute:reason.VISA_ONLY.cur: Bu faqat viza uchun kerak. U hali hujjatlaringiz orasida yoʻq.

visaroute:reason.WAITING_UNIVERSITY.en: {{university}} sends this. Nothing to do until it arrives.
visaroute:reason.WAITING_UNIVERSITY.cur: Buni {{university}} yuboradi. U kelguncha hech narsa qilish shart emas.

visaroute:route.feeAmount.en: {{amount}} {{currency}}, paid to the embassy, not to Hangyul

visaroute:route.feeUnknown.en: The fee isn't confirmed. Your counselor checks the current amount.
visaroute:route.feeUnknown.cur: Yigʻim miqdori tasdiqlanmagan. Maslahatchingiz hozirgi summani aniqlaydi.

visaroute:route.postPending.en: Where you apply depends on where you live. Answer one question below.
visaroute:route.postPending.cur: Qayerda ariza berishingiz yashash joyingizga bogʻliq. Quyidagi bitta savolga javob bering.

visaroute:route.processing.en: Processing time, in the embassy's own words
visaroute:route.processing.cur: Koʻrib chiqish muddati, elchixonaning oʻz soʻzlari bilan

visaroute:state.IN_KOREA.en: You're already in Korea. You change your visa status at an immigration office, not at an embassy. Your counselor guides you.
visaroute:state.IN_KOREA.cur: Siz allaqachon Koreyadasiz. Viza maqomini elchixonada emas, immigratsiya idorasida oʻzgartirasiz. Maslahatchingiz yoʻl-yoʻriq beradi.

visaroute:state.NEEDS_PROGRAM.en: Choose a programme first. The visa type depends on what you study.
visaroute:state.NEEDS_PROGRAM.cur: Avval dasturni tanlang. Viza turi nima oʻqishingizga bogʻliq.

visaroute:state.NO_ROUTE.en: We haven't verified the rules for {{country}} yet. Your counselor confirms them.
visaroute:state.NO_ROUTE.cur: {{country}} uchun qoidalarni hali tekshirmaganmiz. Maslahatchingiz ularni aniqlaydi.

visaroute:state.OTHER_RESIDENCE.en: You live in {{country}}, so you usually apply at the Korean embassy or consulate there. We haven't verified that route. Your counselor confirms it.
visaroute:state.OTHER_RESIDENCE.cur: Siz {{country}}da yashaysiz, shuning uchun odatda u yerdagi Koreya elchixonasi yoki konsulligiga ariza berasiz. Bu yoʻlni hali tekshirmaganmiz. Maslahatchingiz aniqlaydi.

visaroute:step.apply.title.cur: Ariza bering va kvitansiyani qayd eting

visaroute:step.apply.why.en: Submit your documents, then enter the receipt number here.
visaroute:step.apply.why.cur: Hujjatlaringizni topshiring, soʻng kvitansiya raqamini shu yerga kiriting.

visaroute:step.documents.why.en: We reuse what you already have. Add only what is new for the visa.
visaroute:step.documents.why.cur: Bor hujjatlaringizdan qayta foydalanamiz. Faqat viza uchun yangi kerak boʻlganlarini qoʻshing.

visaroute:step.fresh_items.title.cur: Muddati cheklangan hujjatlarni eng oxirida oling

visaroute:step.slow_items.why.en: Apostilles or consular legalization, the TB test and police certificates can take weeks.
visaroute:step.slow_items.why.cur: Apostil yoki konsullik legallashtiruvi, sil (TB) tekshiruvi va politsiya maʼlumotnomalari haftalab vaqt olishi mumkin.

visaroute:step.university_papers.why.en: The admission letter and business registration certificate come from the university.
visaroute:step.university_papers.why.cur: Qabul xati va davlat roʻyxatidan oʻtganlik guvohnomasini universitet yuboradi.

visaroute:timing.noDate.en: Must be issued within {{days}} days before you apply. Choose your application date first, then get it.
visaroute:timing.noDate.cur: Ariza berishdan oldingi {{days}} kun ichida berilgan boʻlishi kerak. Avval ariza sanasini tanlang, keyin uni oling.

visaroute:track.appointmentHint.en: Book it through the embassy's official system, then note the date here. We check that your documents are still valid on that day.
visaroute:track.appointmentHint.cur: Elchixonaning rasmiy tizimi orqali navbat oling, soʻng sanani shu yerga yozing. Oʻsha kuni hujjatlaringiz hali amal qilishini tekshiramiz.

visaroute:track.handoffText.en: You'll book on the embassy's official page. Your plan stays here, so come back and note the date and your receipt number.
visaroute:track.handoffText.cur: Navbatni elchixonaning rasmiy sahifasida olasiz. Rejangiz shu yerda qoladi, shuning uchun qaytib kelib, sana va ariza raqamingizni yozib qoʻying.

visaroute:track.issuedDone.en: Visa issued on {{date}}. Plan your arrival next.
visaroute:track.issuedDone.cur: Viza {{date}} kuni berildi. Endi kelishingizni rejalashtiring.

visaroute:track.issuedText.en: Upload your visa (or the e-visa grant notice). Then you can start your arrival plan.
visaroute:track.issuedText.cur: Vizangizni (yoki elektron viza berilganligi haqidagi xabarnomani) yuklang. Shundan keyin kelish rejangizni boshlashingiz mumkin.

visaroute:v5.helpAsk.en: Ask the Hangyul team about your visa

visaroute:verify.PARTIAL.en: Mostly confirmed on {{date}}. Some details below are still being checked.
visaroute:verify.PARTIAL.cur: {{date}} kuni asosan tasdiqlangan. Quyidagi ayrim tafsilotlar hali tekshirilmoqda.

visaroute:why.CCVI_POSSIBLE.en: Your university may also apply for a Certificate of Confirmation of Visa Issuance (CCVI) for you. Your counselor tells you if it will.
visaroute:why.CCVI_POSSIBLE.cur: Universitetingiz siz uchun viza berishni tasdiqlovchi sertifikat (CCVI) ham soʻrashi mumkin. Shunday boʻlsa, maslahatchingiz aytadi.

visaroute:why.CCVI_REQUIRED.en: For your nationality and this programme at {{university}}, the university must first get a Certificate of Confirmation of Visa Issuance (CCVI).
visaroute:why.CCVI_REQUIRED.cur: Fuqaroligingiz va {{university}}dagi bu dastur uchun universitet avval viza berishni tasdiqlovchi sertifikat (CCVI) olishi kerak.

visaroute:why.EVISA_TIER.en: {{university}} is certified for the e-visa, so the university applies for it for you. You don't need to visit the embassy.
visaroute:why.EVISA_TIER.cur: {{university}} elektron viza uchun sertifikatlangan, shuning uchun universitet siz uchun ariza beradi. Elchixonaga borishingiz shart emas.

visaroute:why.POST_BY_REGION.en: You live in the area that the Korean embassy or consulate in {{city}} covers, so you apply there.
visaroute:why.POST_BY_REGION.cur: Siz {{city}}dagi Koreya elchixonasi yoki konsulligi xizmat qiladigan hududda yashaysiz, shuning uchun oʻsha yerga ariza berasiz.

visaroute:why.POST_FOR_COUNTRY.en: Students living in {{country}} apply at the Korean embassy or consulate in {{city}}.
visaroute:why.POST_FOR_COUNTRY.cur: {{country}}da yashovchi talabalar {{city}}dagi Koreya elchixonasi yoki konsulligiga ariza beradi.

visaroute:why.rule.en: Apply where you live (or where you last studied), and only through the embassy's official channels.
visaroute:why.rule.cur: Yashaydigan joyingizda (yoki oxirgi oʻqigan joyingizda) va faqat elchixonaning rasmiy kanallari orqali ariza bering.

concierge:arrived.confirmText.en: We'll record today as your arrival date. You need to apply for your residence card within 90 days.
concierge:arrived.confirmText.cur: Bugungi sanani kelgan kuningiz sifatida qayd etamiz. Chet ellik roʻyxat kartasiga 90 kun ichida ariza berishingiz kerak.

concierge:arrived.text.en: Tell us you've arrived. We'll start your residence card countdown and show your steps for the first weeks.
concierge:arrived.text.cur: Yetib kelganingizni ayting — roʻyxat kartasi uchun muddat hisobini boshlaymiz va ilk haftalaringiz qadamlariga oʻtamiz.

concierge:cost.included.en: Included in your Hangyul plan at no extra cost

concierge:emergency.note.en: In an emergency, call first. Then tell the Hangyul team.
concierge:emergency.note.cur: Favqulodda vaziyatda avval qoʻngʻiroq qiling. Keyin Hangyul jamoasiga xabar bering.

concierge:feedback.gaveNo.en: You told us this didn't go well. Your team will contact you.
concierge:feedback.gaveNo.cur: Siz bu yaxshi oʻtmaganini aytdingiz — jamoangiz siz bilan bogʻlanadi.

concierge:feedback.thanks.en: Thank you. This helps us improve.
concierge:feedback.thanks.cur: Rahmat — bu bizga yaxshilanishga yordam beradi.

concierge:flight.notLive.en: You or your counselor enter the flight times. They are not live airline data.
concierge:flight.notLive.cur: Reys vaqtlarini siz yoki maslahatchingiz kiritgan — bu aviakompaniyaning jonli maʼlumoti emas.

concierge:help.sentOps.en: Sent. Hangyul's operations team has it.
concierge:help.sentOps.cur: Yuborildi — Hangyul operatsion jamoasi qabul qildi.

concierge:help.sideText.en: Ask about housing, your university, visa, documents or payments in one place.
concierge:help.sideText.cur: Turar joy, universitet, viza, hujjatlar yoki toʻlovlar haqida bir joyda soʻrang.

concierge:help.subtitle.en: Tell us what happened. The right person on your team gets it immediately.
concierge:help.subtitle.cur: Nima boʻlganini ayting. Jamoangizdagi masʼul xodim buni darhol koʻradi.

concierge:hero.arrived.en: Welcome to Korea! You arrived on {{date}}.
concierge:hero.arrived.cur: Koreyaga xush kelibsiz! Siz {{date}} da yetib keldingiz.

concierge:housing.askedToast.en: Sent. Your team will arrange a viewing.

concierge:housing.compare.OFF_CAMPUS.en: More choice and privacy. You need a deposit (often large) and a contract. Your counselor can review it with you before you sign.
concierge:housing.compare.OFF_CAMPUS.cur: Tanlov kengroq va shaxsiy hayot erkinroq. Depozit (koʻpincha katta) va shartnoma kerak — imzolashdan oldin maslahatchingiz uni siz bilan koʻrib chiqishi mumkin.

concierge:housing.dormExplain.NOT_ASSIGN.en: No room this time. Your counselor will help you with other options.
concierge:housing.dormExplain.NOT_ASSIGN.cur: Bu safar xona berilmadi — maslahatchingiz boshqa variantlar bilan yordam beradi.

concierge:housing.foundOwnSub.en: Share the contract before you sign. Your counselor checks it with you.
concierge:housing.foundOwnSub.cur: Imzolashdan oldin shartnomani yuboring — maslahatchingiz uni siz bilan tekshiradi.

concierge:housing.honest.en: We show only dormitory facts with a source, and only rooms a provider has actually offered, each labeled. We never invent listings.
concierge:housing.honest.cur: Yotoqxonalar haqida faqat manbasi bor maʼlumotlarni, xonalardan esa faqat provayder haqiqatan taklif qilganlarini belgilab koʻrsatamiz. Hech qachon eʼlon oʻylab topmaymiz.

concierge:housing.listingsSub.en: Every room comes from a named provider.
concierge:housing.listingsSub.cur: Har bir xona nomi koʻrsatilgan xizmat koʻrsatuvchidan.

concierge:housing.subtitle.en: Choose where you'll live. We'll guide you through the rest.
concierge:housing.subtitle.cur: Qayerda yashashingizni tanlang. Qolgan bosqichlarda sizga yoʻl koʻrsatamiz.

concierge:housing.tempRequested.en: Sent. Your team will suggest options.

concierge:lease.intro.en: Upload the proposed contract and fill in what you can read. Your counselor reviews it with you. We check for missing or unclear terms. This is not legal advice.
concierge:lease.intro.cur: Taklif qilingan shartnomani yuklang va oʻqiy olganingizni toʻldiring. Maslahatchingiz uni siz bilan koʻrib chiqadi. Biz yetishmayotgan yoki noaniq shartlarni tekshiramiz — bu huquqiy maslahat emas.

concierge:lease.sent.en: Sent. Your counselor will review it with you.
concierge:lease.sent.cur: Yuborildi — maslahatchingiz uni siz bilan koʻrib chiqadi.

concierge:moveIn.item.address_report.tex.en: Once you have a residence card, you must report your new address within 15 days of moving.
concierge:moveIn.item.address_report.tex.cur: Roʻyxat kartasini olganingizdan keyin koʻchsangiz, yangi manzilni koʻchganingizdan 15 kun ichida maʼlum qilishingiz shart.

concierge:official.needsReview.en: We're still confirming this with the official source. Check with your counselor before you rely on it.
concierge:official.needsReview.cur: Buni hali rasmiy manba bilan tasdiqlamoqdamiz — unga tayanishdan oldin maslahatchingiz bilan aniqlang.

concierge:page.subtitle.en: From where you'll live to your residence card, one step at a time.

concierge:pickup.explain.FLIGHT_DELAYED.en: Your flight is late, so the pickup time has been moved. You don't need to do anything.
concierge:pickup.explain.FLIGHT_DELAYED.cur: Reysingiz kechikmoqda — kutib olish vaqti oʻzgartirildi. Hech narsa qilishingiz shart emas.

concierge:pickup.explain.NO_SHOW.en: The driver couldn't find you. Your team will contact you, or you can open 'Need help in Korea?'.
concierge:pickup.explain.NO_SHOW.cur: Haydovchi sizni topa olmadi. Jamoangiz siz bilan bogʻlanadi — yoki “Koreyada yordam kerakmi?” boʻlimini oching.

concierge:pickup.handle.en: Your username or phone number on that app
concierge:pickup.handle.cur: Oʻsha ilovadagi foydalanuvchi nomingiz yoki telefon raqamingiz

concierge:pickup.needFlight.en: Add your flight first. We plan the pickup around your arrival time.
concierge:pickup.needFlight.cur: Avval reysingizni qoʻshing — kutib olish yetib kelish vaqtingizga qarab rejalashtiriladi.

concierge:pickup.requested.en: Pickup requested. Your team will confirm it.
concierge:pickup.requested.cur: Kutib olish soʻraldi — jamoangiz uni tasdiqlaydi.

concierge:profile.sub.en: We only ask what affects your options.
concierge:profile.sub.cur: Faqat tanlovingizga taʼsir qiladigan narsalarni soʻraymiz.

concierge:residence.bookText.en: HiKorea is the government website. Hangyul can't book for you or store your HiKorea password. Book there, then come back and tell us the date.
concierge:residence.bookText.cur: HiKorea — davlat sayti. Hangyul siz uchun band qila olmaydi va HiKorea parolingizni saqlay olmaydi. U yerda band qiling, soʻng qaytib kelib sanani bizga ayting.

concierge:residence.groupNo.en: Your university does not apply as a group. Book your own visit on HiKorea.
concierge:residence.groupNo.cur: Universitetingiz guruh boʻlib topshirmaydi — HiKorea orqali tashrifni oʻzingiz band qiling.

concierge:residence.groupUnknown.en: Ask your international office whether they apply for residence cards as a group. If not, book your own visit on HiKorea.
concierge:residence.groupUnknown.cur: Xalqaro boʻlimingizdan chet ellik roʻyxat kartasiga guruh boʻlib ariza berishadimi, soʻrang. Agar yoʻq boʻlsa, HiKorea orqali tashrifni oʻzingiz band qiling.

concierge:residence.groupYes.en: Your university applies for residence cards as a group. You can choose that instead of booking your own visit.
concierge:residence.groupYes.cur: Universitetingiz roʻyxat kartalari uchun arizalarni guruh boʻlib topshiradi — tashrifni oʻzingiz band qilish oʻrniga shuni tanlashingiz mumkin.

concierge:residence.lateText.en: Contact your counselor today. They'll help you with the immigration office.
concierge:residence.lateText.cur: Bugun maslahatchingiz bilan bogʻlaning — u immigratsiya idorasi bilan bogʻliq masalada yordam beradi.

concierge:residence.useGroup.en: My university is applying for me

concierge:residence.waiting.en: Submitted. The card usually takes one to several weeks, depending on the office. Don't leave Korea while you wait unless immigration says you can.
concierge:residence.waiting.cur: Topshirildi — idoraga qarab karta odatda bir haftadan bir necha haftagacha tayyorlanadi. Ariza koʻrib chiqilayotganda, immigratsiya xizmati ruxsat bermasa, Koreyadan chiqib ketmang.

concierge:step.documents_to_carry.text.en: Keep the originals in your hand luggage. You'll need them for your residence card in your first weeks:
concierge:step.documents_to_carry.text.cur: Asl nusxalarni qoʻl yukingizda saqlang — ilk haftalaringizda roʻyxat kartasi uchun ular kerak boʻladi:

concierge:step.pickup.sub.en: Your pickup partner meets you at arrivals
concierge:step.pickup.sub.cur: Hamkor haydovchi sizni kelish zalida kutib oladi

concierge:step.residence_card.why.en: The law requires it if you stay longer than 90 days. You'll need it for your bank account, phone plan and more.
concierge:step.residence_card.why.cur: 90 kundan ortiq qolsangiz, bu qonun boʻyicha majburiy. U bank hisobi, telefon tarifi va boshqa ishlar uchun kerak boʻladi.

concierge:step.residence_setup.text.en: After you land, register for a residence card within 90 days and join National Health Insurance.
concierge:step.residence_setup.text.cur: Qoʻnganingizdan keyin nima boʻladi: 90 kun ichida chet ellik roʻyxat kartasi uchun roʻyxatdan oʻting va Milliy tibbiy sugʻurtaga aʼzo boʻling.

concierge:step.sim_esim.title.en: Phone number and data (SIM or eSIM)
concierge:step.sim_esim.title.cur: Telefon raqami va internet (SIM yoki eSIM)

mobile:v3.quick.dataUnverified.en: Some program details here are not yet verified. Confirm them on the university's official website.
mobile:v3.quick.dataUnverified.cur: Bu yerdagi ayrim dastur maʼlumotlari hali tekshirilmagan. Ularni universitetning rasmiy saytida aniqlang.
